dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The rules context loader and conversation-to-architecture-work steps completed successfully and passed schema validation, showing that governed context was produced and shaped into architecture work. However, the alignment engine failed with a rate-limit error, so no alignment report is evidenced in this trace. The final architecture intent generator also passed schema validation, but the missing alignment step weakens confidence that the final intent fully respected the loaded governance rules.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The trace shows a partial causal chain: rule context was loaded and conversation was successfully converted into architecture work. The critical interruption occurred at architecture-work-to-evolution-map, which failed due to a provider token quota rate limit. As a result, the agent did not produce an evidenced evolution map linking architectural work to future causal states. The successful final intent generation provides some downstream grounding, but the broken intermediate causal step limits the depth of the reasoning chain.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Tension and trade-off analysis is barely evidenced in this trace. The alignment engine, which is the primary step expected to surface architectural tensions and produce reconciliation signals, failed due to a rate-limit error. The architecture-work-to-evolution-map step, which could also have surfaced evolutionary trade-offs, also failed. The final intent generator succeeded in producing schema-valid output, but without the preceding alignment and evolution-map artifacts, the trace does not demonstrate meaningful architectural tension analysis.
